title: Using the Vertical Pod Autoscaler
shortDescription: How to use the Vertical Pod Autoscaler add-on with the Updater component in Recreate mode
metaDescription: Instructions for using the VPA add-on with the Updater component in Recreate mode in Kubernetes. Preparation, creating a Deployment, configuring VPA, testing, and analyzing results. Examples of manifests, kubectl commands, and recommendations on metrics and monitoring
